launch_slurm_job: launch a Slurm job by generating an sbatch script and submitting it via sbatch or bash launcher
copy_python_dir: copy only Python files from an input directory to an output directory using rsync
retrieve_partition_max_time: retrieve the maximum time limit in minutes for each Slurm partition using sinfo
validate_stool_args: validate and set default values for StoolArgs including time limits, constraints, and conda path
run_stool_cli: run the stool module from CLI with OmegaConf dot-list arguments to launch a training job
